name: Rift Breach: Survival
summary:
Wash up on the shattered fragments of a floating world in **Rift Breach: Survival**, an immersive open-world survival sandbox built from the ground up for standalone VR!

Following a mysterious plane crash through a dimensional rift, you are stranded on breathtaking fantasy islands. Paradise turns into a nightmare when the sun goes down and brutal monsters emerge from the rifts. To see another sunrise, you must master the land, build a secure base, and fight back.
